title: Binance says it will make a fresh push for permission to operate in the EU after its MiCA license application in Greece failed ahead of the June 30 deadline (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Binance says it will make a fresh push for permission to operate in the EU after its MiCA license application in Greece failed ahead of the June 30 deadline — Crypto platform Binance intends to stay in the European Union and will make a fresh push for permission to operate there …
